title: swissknifeman vendor-mode config (.swissknifeman/config.json)
description: Legacy (deprecated; use [skiller.sync] in .swissknifeman/config.toml). Source of Truth vendor-mode. Rules (presets ∪ buckets ∪ include) − exclude unfold into a flat set; `skiller sync` copies skills from the library to skills_path and writes skills-lock.json (managed) + .swissknifeman-manifest.json. Keys are kept in sync with SKILLSET_KEYS (lib/skiller/skillset.py) — gate tests/test_schema.py and skiller doctor.

mode.description: Distribution mode. Currently only supported vendor (physical transfer + lock).

agent.description: Informative (claude|cursor|generic). Specifies the path skills_path, not agent.

skills_path.description: Where to copy skills. Default.claude/skills (Claude finds automatically).

presets.description: Named skill clusters (presets/<name>.json), are expanded in buckets/include before the sampling formula.

include.description: Specific skills from any area: 'bucket/rel' or simply 'name'.

exclude.description: Subtract from (presets ∪ buckets ∪ include): skill name or 'bucket/rel'.

gitignore_managed.description: true → sync issue <skills_path>/.gitignore with list managed-skills (keep out git, reproducible `skiller sync`); local/custom skills remain in the repository. Root.gitignore is not touched. ⚠ managed-skills stop committing - suitable when all developers have access to the registry swissknifeman.
